results.title: Sports Can Help Build Drug-Free Society: LG
results.description: Kashmir, Observer, Jammu, Srinagar, Latest Kashmir News, Kashmir News, Kashmir Latest News Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha on Thursday congratulated the Jammu and Kashmir Police on the successful completion of Jashn-e-Dal-2026, saying sports can play a significant role in empowering young people and building a healthy, drug-free society. The post Sports Can Help Build Drug-Free Society: LG appeared first on Kashmir Observer.

results.title: 'You made 140 crore people proud': PM Narendra Modi hails India's Asian Games 2026 participants
results.description: PM Modi heaped praise on the athletes for making the entire nation proud, telling them that true success lies in enhancing the glory of the Tricolour.
